ecmoons.notification.mist_moon.rise: The "Mist Moon" rises... A thick mist rolls in. Distant shapes fade from sight.
ecmoons.notification.mist_moon.set: The "Mist Moon" sets... The mist lifts.
ecmoons.notification.frost_moon.rise: The "Frost Moon" rises... Bitter cold under the open sky. Seek shelter, fire or a warm meal.
ecmoons.notification.frost_moon.set: The "Frost Moon" sets... The cold loosens its grip.
ecmoons.notification.arcane_moon.rise: The "Arcane Moon" rises... Enchanting and repairs come easier tonight.
ecmoons.notification.arcane_moon.set: The "Arcane Moon" sets... The arcane glow fades.
ecmoons.notification.prospector_moon.ris: The "Prospector's Moon" rises... The stone gives up its riches more readily.
ecmoons.notification.wisdom_moon.rise: The "Wisdom Moon" rises... Every lesson tonight is worth twice as much.
ecmoons.notification.quiet_moon.rise: The "Quiet Moon" rises... The night is calm. Rest and recover.
ecmoons.notification.quiet_moon.set: The "Quiet Moon" sets... The night stirs again.
ecmoons.notification.drift_moon.rise: The "Drift Moon" rises... You feel lighter on your feet.
ecmoons.notification.drift_moon.set: The "Drift Moon" sets... Your weight returns. Mind the drop.
ecmoons.notification.revealing_moon.rise: The "Revealing Moon" rises... An eye opens in the sky. Nowhere is hidden for long.
ecmoons.notification.revealing_moon.set: The "Revealing Moon" sets... The eye closes.
ecmoons.notification.thread_moon.rise: The "Thread Moon" rises... Those who stand together are bound together.
ecmoons.notification.thread_moon.set: The "Thread Moon" sets... The threads loosen.
ecmoons.notification.war_moon.rise: The "War Moon" rises... The arena calls for champions.
ecmoons.notification.gluttony_moon.rise: The "Gluttony Moon" rises... Every new taste makes you stronger.
ecmoons.notification.gluttony_moon.set: The "Gluttony Moon" sets... The feast is over.
ecmoons.notification.afterimage_moon.ris: The "Afterimage Moon" rises... Every step leaves a ghost behind.
ecmoons.notification.afterimage_moon.set: The "Afterimage Moon" sets... The echoes fade.
ecmoons.notification.shell_moon.rise: The "Shell Moon" rises... Plates of light await a steady hand.
ecmoons.notification.shell_moon.set: The "Shell Moon" sets... The shells crack and fall away.
ecmoons.notification.wisp_moon.rise: The "Wisp Moon" rises... Small blue spirits answer your call.
ecmoons.notification.wisp_moon.set: The "Wisp Moon" sets... The soul lights gutter out.
